audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart contradicted its own text in three rows: Level 3 was marked Akali while whys[2] calls it a coinflip; Level 6 was marked Jax while whys[4] and spikes[1] both say Perfect Execution is her spike; two items was marked Akali while whys[6] and spikes[3] say the side-lane 1v1 belongs to Jax.
audit.why: The packet levelChart reads Jax / Skill / Skill / Akali / Akali / Akali / Jax, which matches the written reasons. Jax at 51.23% over 1507 games loses the mid-game and takes the lane back at two items.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Jax, Levels 2-3 Skill, Levels 4-6 Akali, first item Akali, two items Jax.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 row credited Jax's ult spike and named it 'Grandmaster’s Might'; the same wrong name appears in breakdown.late.
audit.why: Level 6 belongs to Akali — Perfect Execution (120s at rank 1) is a bigger swing than Jax's R (110s at rank 1). The content layer and the mirror audit both use Grandmaster at Arms.
audit.corrected: Akali's spikes: Level 6 Perfect Execution, then Lich Bane. Jax's: Level 3 full combo, Trinity Force, and the two-item window where R's Armor/MR eats her burst.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer still carried the generic 'Counter Strike flips every AA exchange' line, which reads as though E blanks her whole combo.
audit.why: Riot's own text says Counter Strike dodges incoming ATTACKS. Five Point Strike is an ability and lands through it; the mirror audit flagged exactly this misreading. Twilight Shroud makes her unselectable, which denies the Leap Strike cast outright.
audit.corrected: Counter Strike (17s at rank 1) eats the autos she throws after an E-dash, not Five Point Strike. Twilight Shroud (20s) makes her unselectable, so Leap Strike cannot be cast at her while she sits in it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer refers to Akali as 'he'/'him' in tradeGood, breakdown.mid and dontsFull[0].d.
audit.why: Boilerplate carried over from a male-champion template.

audit.whatIsWrong: The three flagged suspectNames are false positives.
audit.why: 'Hold Counter Strike', 'Drop Twilight Shroud' and 'Her Perfect Execution' are the real Riot names with a verb or pronoun attached.

edits.before: Counter Strike flips every AA exchange he starts. Only take the trade when Akali's Twilight Shroud is down.
edits.after: Skill lane at 2: she chips with Q from range, you threaten the Q-Empower burst — she cannot escape it yet.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Akali must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online, but Counter Strike (17s) dodges only her autos, not Q — hold E for her E-dash commit, then stun.

edits.before: Grandmaster’s Might stats win every extended duel from here on. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Akali's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Perfect Execution's first dash hops your Counter Strike stun and the recast executes on missing health — don't all-in her R.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Akali carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: Grandmaster at Arms' Armor/MR eats her burst and your on-hit ramp out-duels her — Leap Strike her when Shroud is down.

edits.before: Grandmaster’s Might stats win every extended duel from here on — build your teamfight around that. Akali carry threat: 8.5/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Grandmaster at Arms stats win every extended duel from here on — build your teamfight around that. Akali carry threat: 8.5/10 — shift to picks and wave control if she gets ahead.

edits.before: Hold E until Akali commits, Counter-Strike the engage, Q onto him with W loaded, and out-stat the rest.
edits.after: Hold E for the autos after her E-dash, recast for the stun, then Leap Strike in with Empower loaded.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Twilight Shroud: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.
edits.after: Trade strictly around Twilight Shroud (20s): while it is down she cannot break your target lock, so run the pattern. If ahead, freeze and starve her.

edits.before: That is Akali's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: She is unselectable in the smoke — Leap Strike will not cast, and your stun hits nothing.

edits.before: Hold E until Akali commits, Counter-Strike the engage, Q onto him with W loaded, and out-stat the rest.
edits.after: Mercury's Treads plus R's Magic Resist survives her Perfect Execution recast — buy MR before her Lich Bane lands.

notes: Chart rows proposed as full/content pairs and as one atomic group. The content layer here was already strong (mirror-informed); nearly all the damage was in the full layer's generic template text, including the wrong ult name and male pronouns for Akali. Unverified and therefore left alone: whether Twilight Shroud's unselectable state interrupts a Leap Strike already in flight — the kit files do not say, so the page only claims it denies the cast.
